description: This file defines the DbTestAppFactory class used for setting up an in-memory, DB-backed test host environment for the DataAssetBackend application. It manages database provisioning via environment variables, Docker containers, and applies SQL migrations. The class also handles test client creation with authorization headers.

classes.name: DbTestAppFactory
classes.description: A specialized WebApplicationFactory for data asset backend integration tests that require a PostgreSQL database, provisioning via environment variables or Docker containers, and migration setup.

classes.name: DbTestDatabaseProvisioning
classes.description: Contains logic to provision PostgreSQL database for tests, including environment variable parsing, Docker container management, and handling skip conditions.

classes.name: DbTestDatabaseResolution
classes.description: Record type encapsulating the database provider, connection string, and optional container reference for test database resolution.

methods.name: CreateAuthedClient
methods.description: Creates an HTTP client with default authorization header and correlation ID for testing endpoints.

methods.name: ConfigureWebHost
methods.description: Configures the web host environment for tests, injecting connection string and replacing necessary services.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the test environment, provisioning the database, applying migrations, and obtaining auth token.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Cleanly disposes of resources, notably the PostgreSQL container if used.

methods.name: ApplyMigrationsAsync
methods.description: Runs SQL migration scripts to set up the test database schema.
